globalConstraints.rule: The six approved HTML boards override repository legacy and implementation instinct.

enforcement.review: Reject any token, geometry, motion, or carrier that contradicts an extracted board value or caption.

globalConstraints.rule: Workhorse components stay strictly abstract. Only waiting and transition states may channel character power.

enforcement.expressiveAnimation: allowed only for loader, text reveal, success, empty/waiting transition states

globalConstraints.rule: Each character has seven workhorse motif laws. POWER is a separate expressive-only assembly of the same vocabulary.
Light and dark variants use identical component and motif geometry. Theme changes color and whether light is drawn or emitted.
Every Expressive Moments implementation must disable animation when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce and retain a recognizable static state.
Registry v2 components must use the approved theme token ladder; raw board support values must first be promoted to named theme roles.

enforcement.exception: SVG alpha may use a color-mix or named alpha token derived from an approved color.

sourceEvidence.lines: Phase 1 theme requirement and MCP review requirements

geometry.name: chevron
geometry.prototype: Open polyline: (12,24) → (22,12) → (32,24), no fill, 2px accent stroke.

geometry.name: kite
geometry.prototype: 12×12 square outline rotated 45°, 1.8px accent stroke.

geometry.name: node line
geometry.prototype: 1.5px support line with 3px active circles and an outlined pending circle.

geometry.name: buckle
geometry.prototype: 28×14 rounded rectangle frame, rx 3, containing an 8×8 inset buckle frame, rx 1.5.

geometry.name: ring and stem
geometry.prototype: 7px-radius accent ring with a vertical stem descending from y21 to y30.

geometry.name: diagonal
geometry.prototype: Paired directional hairlines using the 114° system axis; primary accent line plus support line.

geometry.name: fragment
geometry.prototype: Narrow 6×14 accent rectangle skewed −18°.

powerAssembly.name: blade-light
powerAssembly.geometry: A 2.4px slash plus a narrow −18° shard; motion follows the 114° fringe axis.

constraints.rule: No elongated pill geometry anywhere in the workhorse set.

allow: true circles used as circuit nodes/status points

constraints.rule: 114° is the only directional system axis.
Light lives in thin lines and seams, not broad decorative fills.

boardCaptions.light: A blade in daylight. Violet-tinted paper, cyan withdrawn to hairlines and state — and seven artifacts from the artwork abstracted into pure geometry: chevron, kite, circuit node, strap-buckle, collar ring, fringe diagonal, light shard.
boardCaptions.dark: Nocturne — the native condition. Dark violet mass, light living in thin emissive seams — carrying the same seven abstracted artifacts: chevron, kite, circuit node, strap-buckle, collar ring, fringe diagonal, light shard.

boardCaptions.light: Collar-ring focus: 1.5px cyan ring with a descending circuit stem — the collar's ring and chest seam.
boardCaptions.dark: Collar-ring focus with descending circuit stem — emissive in the dark.

boardCaptions.light: Rectangular strap track, square buckle-frame thumb — no pill geometry anywhere in the set.
boardCaptions.dark: Rectangular strap track, square buckle-frame thumb — no pill geometry anywhere in the set.

boardCaptions.light: Hovered row carries the hairpin chevron as its leading marker.
boardCaptions.dark: Hovered row carries the hairpin chevron as its leading marker.

boardCaptions.light: Shimmer runs at 114° — the fringe's diagonal, the only angle in the system.
boardCaptions.dark: Shimmer runs at 114° — the fringe's diagonal, the only angle in the system.

boardCaptions.light: Circuit-node dots for healthy rows; a skewed shard marks the degraded one.
boardCaptions.dark: Circuit-node dots for healthy rows; a skewed shard marks the degraded one.

boardCaptions.light: On keyboard focus a 1px cyan line traces the perimeter in 240ms, then settles into the collar ring + stem. Light lives in lines.
boardCaptions.dark: The 240ms perimeter trace, emissive in the dark, settling into the collar ring + stem. Geometry identical to light; only the light behaves differently.

boardCaptions.light: Two-tier rule: workhorse components stay strictly abstract. Only waiting & transition states channel Kira's blade-light — same geometry, drawn as linework in daylight.
boardCaptions.dark: Two-tier rule: workhorse components stay strictly abstract. Only waiting & transition states channel Kira's blade-light — same geometry, emitted as neon light in the dark.

forbidden: broad cyan decoration on workhorse surfaces
blade-light power animation on non-waiting, non-transition workhorses

geometry.name: gold bar
geometry.prototype: 20×10 rounded rectangle frame, rx 3, with short centered side bars.

geometry.name: bead
geometry.prototype: 3.5px rose beads strung on a 1.2px support line; pending bead is gold outline.

geometry.name: moon
geometry.prototype: Subtractive crescent formed from nested arcs.

geometry.name: sparkle
geometry.prototype: Four-point star with long vertical and horizontal tips.

geometry.name: gold rule
geometry.prototype: Parallel horizontal rules: 1.4px gold primary plus 1.4px support line.

geometry.name: curve
geometry.prototype: Single quadratic curve from (8,12) through (22,30) to (36,12).

geometry.name: mist
geometry.prototype: Concentric rose circles at 22% and 50% opacity, implemented as a restrained radial wash.

powerAssembly.name: bloom-orbit
powerAssembly.geometry: A thin gold orbit with rose pearls at graduated opacity, composed with a gold sparkle.

constraints.rule: The system is gracious, never sweet.
Mochi dark is derived from the artwork's mauve backdrop, not black.
Mochi workhorse shimmer and bloom motion eases like fabric settling; it is never brisk.
Warmth is feedback and must be applied with restraint at the interaction point.

boardCaptions.light: Atelier daylight. Warm ivory paper, champagne-gold hairlines, rose held for state. Seven artifacts abstracted to geometry: clasp, pearl, crescent, star, ribbon, drape, veil. Gracious — never sweet.
boardCaptions.dark: Dusk salon — derived from the artwork's mauve backdrop, not from black. Deep warm plum surfaces; gold and rose turn candlelit. The same seven artifacts: clasp, pearl, crescent, star, ribbon, drape, veil.

boardCaptions.light: Bloom focus: the ring arrives inside a soft rose veil that breathes, then settles.
boardCaptions.dark: The bloom warms by candlelight — rose veiled in gold.

boardCaptions.light: Soft-rectangular clasp track; the pearl thumb wears a gold rim. Pressed toggles take the gold clasp frame.
boardCaptions.dark: The pearl thumb keeps its gold rim; by dusk the clasp glows faintly rose.

boardCaptions.light: The hovered row carries a small crescent — the artwork's hanging moons.
boardCaptions.dark: The hovered row carries a small crescent — the artwork's hanging moons.

boardCaptions.light: The shimmer eases like fabric settling — 2.6s, never brisk.
boardCaptions.dark: The shimmer eases like fabric settling — 2.6s, never brisk.

boardCaptions.light: The header rule is gold — the ribbon trim; pearl dots carry status.
boardCaptions.dark: The gold header rule holds by candlelight; pearl dots glow softly.

boardCaptions.light: Focus and selection bloom — a soft radial wash rises from the interaction point and settles, like the artwork's drifting sparkle. Warmth as feedback, applied with restraint.
boardCaptions.dark: By dusk the bloom is candlelit — rose wrapped in a gold undertone, rising from the interaction point and settling. Same geometry as daylight; warmer air.

boardCaptions.light: Two-tier rule: workhorse components stay strictly abstract. Only waiting & transition states channel Mochi's bloom-magic — same geometry, drawn as linework in daylight.
boardCaptions.dark: Two-tier rule: workhorse components stay strictly abstract. Only waiting & transition states channel Mochi's bloom-magic — same geometry, candlelit by dusk.

forbidden: unrestrained full-surface rose or gold glow
bloom-magic animation on non-waiting, non-transition workhorses

geometry.name: frame
geometry.prototype: 28×14 rectangular frame, rx 2, with centered vertical prong slot.

geometry.name: band
geometry.prototype: Repeated 7×5 segments plus a 2px horizontal structural band.

geometry.name: bracket
geometry.prototype: Four independent 90° corner brackets with 2px cobalt stroke.

geometry.name: survey diamond
geometry.prototype: 10×10 outlined square and 5×5 filled square, both rotated 45°.

geometry.name: bezel
geometry.prototype: 24×14 outer frame, rx 3, with 16×8 inset frame, rx 1.5.

geometry.name: ray
geometry.prototype: Paired near-vertical lines at the authored 76° pitch, primary 2.2px and support 1.6px.

geometry.name: ring
geometry.prototype: 8px-radius 2px outline ring with 2.5px filled core.

powerAssembly.name: HUD assembly
powerAssembly.geometry: Core ring composed with docking brackets, scan line, and survey diamond.

constraints.rule: Atlas construction must read as load-bearing, not decorative.
Atlas beam shimmer uses the deliberate 76° near-vertical pitch.
Selection is a structural docking event.

enforcement.focusMechanism: four panel brackets converge and seat around the control

constraints.rule: In dark mode cobalt reads as emitted data radiating from structure, not as broad decorative fill.

boardCaptions.light: Engineering drawing. Cool paper, cobalt linework, gunmetal text — structural and calm. Seven artifacts abstracted to geometry: buckle, strap band, panel bracket, diamond grid, lens bezel, light beam, core ring.
boardCaptions.dark: Blueprint luminescence — the native condition. Ink-navy volume; cobalt reads as emitted data, radiating from structure. The same seven artifacts: buckle, strap band, panel bracket, diamond grid, lens bezel, light beam, core ring.

boardCaptions.light: Dock focus: panel brackets seat around the control — the chest console's frame.
boardCaptions.dark: The docked brackets emit — holographic in the dark.

boardCaptions.light: Rectangular buckle track; the plate thumb carries a prong slot. Load-bearing, not decorative.
boardCaptions.dark: Rectangular buckle track; the plate thumb carries a prong slot. Load-bearing, not decorative.

boardCaptions.light: The hovered row carries a diamond survey point from the backdrop grid.
boardCaptions.dark: The hovered row carries a diamond survey point from the backdrop grid.

boardCaptions.light: Shimmer at 76° — the near-vertical pitch of the artwork's light beams. Deliberate, linear.
boardCaptions.dark: Shimmer at 76° — the near-vertical pitch of the artwork's light beams. Deliberate, linear.

boardCaptions.light: Mono uppercase header — the drawing's title block; diamond survey points carry status.
boardCaptions.dark: Mono uppercase header — the drawing's title block; diamond survey points glow like the backdrop grid.

boardCaptions.light: On focus, four corner brackets converge and seat around the control in 180ms — the holographic panel docking to Atlas's chest console. Selection is a structural event.
boardCaptions.dark: The same 180ms docking, now emissive — the holographic panel seating onto the chest console. Geometry identical to light; the light is emitted instead of drawn.
